infographic.title: From Rotor Speed to Flow Rate
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how a turbine flow meter turns rotor speed into pulses and then into a flow rate using the K factor
steps: Fluid on the angled blades spins the rotor in proportion to its velocity.
A pickup senses the passing blades; each pulse stands for a small volume.
The pickoff frequency is proportional to the flow rate.
Divide frequency by the K factor for flow, or count pulses for the total.
